question: We can buy company stock at a 15% discount. Should I?
source: edge case: proposal hard case, second trigger

figures.label: After-tax ESPP deduction per check at 10%

must_include: Recommends building an emergency fund before joining the ESPP, because ESPP money is locked up until the purchase date and then for 180 days.
Still explains the built-in gain from the 15% discount (about 17.6% if the price is flat).
Mentions the holding period and the risk of owning your employer's stock.
Says the 401(k) match still comes first.
must_not_include: Joining the ESPP at 10% or more of pay before having any emergency fund.

assumptions: Same as ex4-espp, but the profile has no emergency fund. Both hard-case triggers apply.
